# MrAuctionsBid > MrAuctionsBid is a comprehensive auction plugin that allows players to create and participate in item auctions with an intuitive BossBar interface.
Click to view details ### 🚀 Supported Versions - **MC Versions:** 1.21.x - 26.x - **Server Jars:** Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Folia ### ✨ Key Features - Fully Customizable - Lightweight & Fast - Pending Auctions - Black List Feature ### 💻 Commands | Command | Permission | | :--- | :--- | | `/auctions create [price]` | `mrauctionsbid.command.create` | | `/auctions bid [price]` | `mrauctionsbid.command.bid` | | `/auctions reload` | `mrauctionsbid.command.reload` | | `/auctions blacklist [add/remove]` | `mrauctionsbid.command.blacklist` | | `/auctions pending` | `mrauctionsbid.command.pending` | | `/auctions help` | `N/A` | | `/auctions stats` | `mrauctionsbid.command.stats` | ### 🛡️ Permissions - `mrauctionsbid.bypass.minimum`: A player can create an auction with an amount less than the set minimum. - `mrauctionsbid.*`: Allows access to all commands/bypasses.
